Comparing (a) Standard training and (b) OPT:
- Subplot (a) "Standard training" shows more abrupt changes and sharper edges in the surface, with a steeper, more sudden drop to the minimum
- Subplot (b) "OPT" shows a more gradual, smoother gradient from the high values (red) down to the low values (blue), with more evenly distributed contour lines
